Section Name: remembered_devices
Corresponds to: Remembered Devices
This section affects how and when users can skip subsequent 2FA and Duo
Passwordless (if enabled) login requests.
Note: Passwordless users will be able to remember devices for no longer than three
days, regardless of the selected length of time entered via max_time_units  and
